packet_scope: Lecture-specific PDFs linked in each queued row of the official lecture-notes index. L32 has two required assets. Four unit compilation links are recorded as aggregate alternatives and not counted as additional required session assets.
method: Resolved the lecture-specific resource pages from the official MIT OCW notes index and the actual PDF asset URLs from those resource pages.
Downloaded all required files; retained SHA-256 hashes, bytes, page counts, official URLs and local evidence paths.
Extracted text and rendered every PDF page with PyMuPDF at 2x (1224 x 1584 pixels).

Actually viewed every one of the 185 content-page images individually, including the complete extra L32 review PDF; inspected all 35 covers using full-page overview and enlarged text crop. L01-L03 also had full-packet contact-sheet overviews.
Used visual inspection to resolve equation and figure readability; nonempty extracted text by itself was not treated as sufficient.
limitations: Readability/capability admission only. No substantive teaching document review, PROF iteration, SASIS, mathematical correctness certification or authoring is claimed.

Complete packet means the session-specific note assets on the official notes index. It does not assert that these notes exhaust every spoken or board/demonstration detail of a separate lecture recording, or every referenced homework/textbook item.
Some source typos are plainly legible; incidental examples are recorded separately and do not change readability eligibility.
Raw text extraction can reorder or flatten equations; the PDF renders remain the primary evidence for mathematical notation and visual content.
render_recovery_log: Two initially empty local PNGs (L03/lec3-p02.png and L16/lec16-p04.png) were rerendered sequentially from the intact PDFs, verified as valid images, and visually inspected before admission. This was a local render transient, not a source readability failure.
A tool result containing L31/L32 images was context-truncated; those pages were emitted again in smaller batches and actually inspected. No truncated output was counted as inspection.
